scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n auth,flight,booking,gateway,notification -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm --prefix auth-service run dev" "npm --prefix flight-service run dev" "npm --prefix booking-service run dev" "npm --prefix api-gateway run dev" "npm --prefix notification-service run dev"
scripts.dev:fresh: npm run dev:stop && npm run dev
scripts.install:services: npm --prefix auth-service install && npm --prefix flight-service install && npm --prefix booking-service install && npm --prefix api-gateway install && npm --prefix notification-service install
scripts.db:migrate: npm --prefix auth-service run db:migrate && npm --prefix flight-service run db:migrate && npm --prefix booking-service run db:migrate
